product.name: Amazon Brand - Rivet Modern Geometric Oval Wire Baskets, Set of 3, 7.25"H, 5"H, and 5"H, Gold
product.description: This stunning collection of geometric metal wire baskets provides a delightful mix of art and efficiency. With the option to keep them together as a set of three or spread the joy around, you'll find a plethora of possibility with these functional art pieces. Large: 18.25"W x 17"D x 7.25”H, Medium: 16.25"W x 15"D x 6”H, Small: 14.25"W x 13.25"D x 5”H 3 nesting baskets formed of metal wire with a gold finish Useful for storing small items This elegant work of modern art and craftsmanship is perfect as a collection of three or spread out. Avoid moisture and wipe clean with a soft, dry cloth.
